cohort: Infants born between 2006 and 2012 in the Netherlands and Sweden with sagittal or metopic suture synostosis
finding: Scaphocephaly was associated with more postterm births and an increased rate of cesarean sections, while trigonocephaly was related to assisted reproductive technology and higher rates of breech position and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in both scaphocephaly and trigonocephaly groups.
